A '''battle''' was fought in the [[Yag'Dhul system/Legends|Yag'Dhul system]] during [[Operation Shadow Hand]] of [[10 ABY/Legends|10]] to [[11 ABY/Legends|11 ABY]].<ref name="TEA" />

{{Battle-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The battle of Cyrillia was first shown marked on a map in ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', a [[2009]] reference book written by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]]. The battle was not mentioned in the text of the book.<ref name="TEA" />
